sections.draft_content:
## Clinical Delivery — Clinical Operations

### Sites and coverage

HealthCore will serve Meridian Manufacturing from its Austin, Texas clinic (us-tx-001). This clinic is the closest HealthCore site to the client’s facility. The contract requires an on-site clinic at the client’s location, not at a HealthCore clinic. HealthCore will deploy a mobile or modular clinic unit on-site. Coverage is 3 days per week. We will confirm exact hours per day with the client.

### Staffing and capacity

The on-site clinic needs a mix of clinical staff to cover injury triage, annual screenings, and chronic care. We propose one Registered Nurse (RN) and one Nurse Practitioner (NP) for 3 days per week. A physician (MD) will provide remote supervision and periodic on-site visits. This team can handle 800 annual screenings within the contract term. We must confirm current staff availability at us-tx-001. HealthCore does not have published staff capacity per clinic. Clinical Operations will verify capacity before finalizing.

### Clinical services

- Injury and illness triage and treatment for workplace incidents.
- Annual wellness screenings for all 800 employees.
- Chronic condition management for diabetes and hypertension.
- Health coaching and care coordination for chronic conditions.
- Lab work for screenings (e.g., blood draws) will be arranged through a third-party lab.

### Open questions

- What are the specific clinic hours per day?
- Is there existing clinic space or equipment provided by the client?
- What is the expected volume of injury visits per week or month?
- Are there any specific languages required for staff?
- What is the budget range for staffing?
- Can HealthCore confirm current staff capacity at us-tx-001 for this contract?

## Data Protection and Compliance — Compliance and Data Governance

### Regulatory framework
HealthCore complies with the HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164). Meridian Manufacturing receives only aggregate, de-identified program reports. Individual health records are never shared with the client. All protected health information (PHI) is used and disclosed only for treatment, payment, and health care operations. We apply the minimum necessary standard to every data request.

### Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
The RFP requires a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before contract execution. HealthCore will provide a standard HIPAA-compliant BAA. This agreement defines permitted uses of PHI, safeguards, and breach notification procedures. We notify Meridian Manufacturing of any PHI breach within 60 days of discovery. The BAA covers administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for all PHI handled under this program.

### Compliance approval
Claire Whitfield, Chief Compliance Officer, must review and approve the BAA and overall compliance framework before HealthCore signs the contract. This approval is mandatory and non-waivable. No work involving PHI begins until approval is granted.

### Open questions
- Are there any specific data security requirements or certifications (e.g., SOC 2, HITRUST) expected by the client?
- What is the process for breach notification and incident response under the BAA?

## Commercial Terms — Revenue Cycle

### Pricing and currency
We quote all prices in USD. The pricing model is per employee per month (PEPM). For 800 covered employees, the monthly fee is [amount to be confirmed by Revenue Cycle]. This covers occupational health and corporate wellness services. The annual contract value is [amount to be confirmed by Revenue Cycle]. We do not include performance-based adjustments at this stage.

### Payment structure
HealthCore invoices monthly. Payment terms are [payment terms to be confirmed by Revenue Cycle]. We do not offer discounts for annual prepayment unless specified. Invoices include a detailed breakdown of services. Financial reports are available upon request.

### Contract term
The initial term is 12 months, starting on the agreed start date. The client may renew for additional periods under terms to be negotiated. Renewal pricing will reflect any changes in scope or volume.

### Open questions
- What is the exact pricing model and unit cost?
- What are the payment schedule and invoicing requirements?
- Are there any performance-based pricing adjustments or penalties?
- What financial reports or deliverables are expected during the contract term?
- What are the renewal pricing terms and conditions?

synthesis.summary: La RFP de Meridian Manufacturing solicita servicios de salud ocupacional y bienestar corporativo para 800 empleados, con un contrato de 12 meses y opción de renovación. Los requisitos clave incluyen una clínica in situ 3 días/semana, exámenes anuales, manejo de enfermedades crónicas y triaje de lesiones. El cliente otorga un 25% de peso a cumplimiento y seguridad de datos, exigiendo un BAA. Los detalles de precios no están especificados, por lo que debemos proponer una estructura.
next_steps: Definir modelo de precios (por empleado/mes, tarifa fija o escalonada) y términos de pago (mensual, trimestral, descuento por pago anual) — Revenue Cycle (Tom Callahan)
Evaluar dotación de personal clínico (enfermeros, médicos) para 3 días/semana, confirmar horarios y capacidad para 800 exámenes anuales — Clinical Operations (Dr. Marcus Reid)
Preparar BAA estándar conforme a HIPAA y documentar prácticas de seguridad de datos (salvaguardas administrativas, físicas y técnicas) — Compliance and Data Governance (Claire Whitfield)
